tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search the driver's phone contacts by name, nickname or relationship (e.g. "Pipe", "my brother"). Returns candidates with IDs and the number types each contact has. Does not call anyone.

query.description: Name, nickname or relationship as the driver said it.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get the full record of one contact by ID, including its phone number types.

contact_id.description: ID of the contact, as returned by a search function.

tools.name: call_contact
tools.description: Start a phone call to a contact by ID. Resolve the contact with search_contacts first. If number_type is omitted the contact's default number is used.

contact_id.description: ID of the contact, as returned by a search function.

number_type.description: Which of the contact's numbers to call.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a contact by ID. Resolve the contact with search_contacts first.

contact_id.description: ID of the contact, as returned by a search function.

text.description: Message text, as dictated by the driver.

number_type.description: Which of the contact's numbers to use (default: mobile, else the default number).

tools.name: search_media
tools.description: Search the car's media library (songs, artists, albums, playlists, radio stations, podcasts) by title, name, frequency or genre. Returns candidates with IDs. Does not play anything.

query.description: Title, artist, station name or frequency, or genre as the driver said it.

types.description: Restrict to these media types, in order of preference.

tools.name: play_media
tools.description: Play a media item by ID (track, artist, album, playlist, station or podcast). Resolve the item with search_media first.

item_id.description: ID of the media item, as returned by a search function.

shuffle.description: Shuffle the items of an artist, album or playlist.

tools.name: get_playback_state
tools.description: Get what is currently playing, if anything.

tools.name: search_poi
tools.description: Search points of interest (places) by name, brand or category, near the vehicle, along the active route, or near the destination. Needs at least one of query or category. Returns candidates with IDs, network distance in meters and whether they are open now.

query.description: Place name, brand or kind of place as the driver said it.

scope.description: Where to search (default near_vehicle). along_route and near_destination need an active route.

radius_m.description: Search radius in meters along the road network (default 3000).

open_now.description: Only places that are open now.

tools.name: get_poi
tools.description: Get the full record of one point of interest by ID, including opening hours and attributes.

poi_id.description: ID of the point of interest, as returned by a search function.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Start route guidance to a point of interest by ID, replacing any active route. Resolve the place with search_poi first.

poi_id.description: ID of the point of interest, as returned by a search function.

tools.name: add_waypoint
tools.description: Add a stop at a point of interest (by ID) to the active route, before the destination. Fails with no_route when no route is active.

poi_id.description: ID of the point of interest, as returned by a search function.

tools.name: end_task
tools.description: End the current task. Use completed when the request was carried out, not_possible when it cannot be fulfilled (for example the contact, item or place does not exist), and needs_user when you hand control back to the driver.

reason.description: Short reason, e.g. "No contact named Camila".
